claim.scope: Standalone actual-input GPU recurrence experiment at the pinned shape/input/device. Dense affine scan is rejected for promotion on these short blocks; serial tile is bit-exact in the tested scope with a descriptive local timing lead. No production integration, refreshed upstream parity, full-prefill/WAV gain, audio-quality or universal scan claim.
claim.attestation: Locally generated receipts and correlated source review; not an independently attested build or replicated GPU run.

decision.serial_tile: retain as next bounded production-prefill integration candidate
decision.rollback: Omit standalone diagnostic; no production route to disable.
decision.next_falsifier: Integrate ordered serial tile into known-input prefill. Preserve convolution history and every output/state bit, charge preparation/normalization/projection/commit, then refresh upstream boundary and complete-WAV pairs.

compiled_source_binding_scope: Nineteen listed diagnostic, capture, input-preparation, comparison and kernel sources checked against compiled bytes before setup and report creation. Not every transitive dependency.

runtime.device: Apple M2 Max, 38 GPU cores, 64 GiB unified memory
runtime.model_hash_scope: Config/tokenizer/index and five backbone model shards hashed after each probe; DAC unused. Both receipts match; not independently rehashed at closure.
runtime.heavy_run_policy: Root-only serial run_safe with external scratch, local weights and 15 percent free-memory floor. Uncontrolled shared-host load; unrelated processes and live Studio untouched.

input.text: Hello, this is a voice test.

correctness.native_sequential_replay_vs_capture: bit-exact output/final state in every group

affine_scan.first_output_drift: Size 8: local row 16 from zero S0, row 8 from nonzero S0. Size-16 nonzero starts first differ at row 16. One-block and size-16 zero-state controls do not exercise composed-prefix replay.

correctness.native_gate: zero output/state/prefix finite bit differences; nonfinite rejects
correctness.tolerance_metric_only: 6e-5 + 3e-4 * abs(reference), unchanged; does not override native bit gate
correctness.upstream_status: The prior strict row-1/layer-39 mismatch remains open in the earlier GDN-post qualification; no new upstream run here.
correctness.audible_observation: User reports no quality defect in examples they heard. This is separate listening evidence, not a strict numerical pass or proof that the mismatch never affects audio.

gpu_residency_and_boundaries.capture_adds: GPU copy dispatches and approximately 120 MiB of all-row state tables for two layers, outside timing arms.
gpu_residency_and_boundaries.encode_guard: Runtime graph/readback ledgers must be identical around capture and each mode encoder. Comparison reads and timing completion occur outside those encoders.
gpu_residency_and_boundaries.scratch_bytes_scope: Only two affine summary buffers and prefix states: 40/30 MiB at size 8 for 29/19 rows, 20 MiB at size 16, 10 MiB at one block. Excludes output/final states, captures, model resources and validation.
gpu_residency_and_boundaries.retained_byte_scope: Conservative CogniGraph backing-resource accounting; not physical unified-memory allocation. Terminal retained bytes are zero.
gpu_residency_and_boundaries.existing_production_control_reads: Unchanged per-frame EOS and finite-control boundaries; diagnostic does not claim their removal.

timing.source: Join JSON arm indices to unique positive GPU-command durations in the matching preserved stderr log.
timing.arm_order: ABBA: reference-first for pair index modulo four 0 or 3, candidate-first otherwise.
timing.caveat: Descriptive warm resident recurrence-corridor timings, shared-host load uncontrolled. Depth-2 intervals may overlap and are not additive. No confidence interval, causal request speedup or decode gain claim.
timing.cohort_statistics: Full per-cohort gate/ratio/time statistics are in the hashed depth0-analysis.json and depth2-analysis.json; the qualification document contains the comparison table.

verification.commands: Exact build/run/analysis commands and expected scope are in docs/drama3-gdn-scan.md; raw build/test/run logs are hashed below.
verification.metal_dod: Release specs for drama3_gdn_scan_spec.cr and existing drama3_prefill_spec.cr; 6 examples, 0 failures. Real model probes complete at depths 0 and 2.
verification.offline_dod: Ten analyzer tests plus both actual report/log analyses pass; candidate failures remain visible in output gates.

root_adversary.other_checks: Two live selected-source/executable bindings, two warmup-drift gate checks, one cross-depth source/model/numerical receipt check.

verification.review: Correlated mini-Quadrum source/math/evidence challenges and root command execution; final scoped review returned ROBUST. Arbitrary fabricated receipts are not authenticated by structural validation.
verification.artifact_validation: JSON parsing plus dereferenced file/source digest checks. No repository landmark graph validator exists; packet is a curated evidence index, not a proof.

refresh.operation: Repeat scoped release GPU checks and actual-input depth-0/2 probes with fresh output names, then join each report to its matching timeline log. Production integration additionally needs upstream and complete-request checks.
refresh.failure_policy: Keep diagnostic-only, reopen affected claims, preserve the current tolerances.
